latest_release.body:
**OpenAI request fix and stability**

### Highlights

- Fix OpenAI models failing every turn with invalid_request_error due to a rejected tool schema
- Recover the TUI from a vanished or unresponsive server instead of retrying forever
- Native Muse subscription login and Venice AI provider support

### Improvements

- Add configurable Kagi web search backend
- Add persistent /latex rendering controls
- Show live stopwatch, context, and token stats per swarm worker

### Fixes

- Honor the configured model for fresh sessions
- Report token counts for OpenAI native compaction
- Reject stale patch hunks before any file changes
- Keep swarm workers alive across reloads
- Fix OAuth credential handoff and stale daemon token recovery
- Fix Kitty images in Zellij

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.99.0...v0.99.1

<!-- jcode-platform-availability:start -->
## Platform availability

- Linux x86_64: available
- Linux aarch64: available
- macOS Apple Silicon: available
- macOS Intel: available
- Windows x86_64: available
- Windows ARM64: available
- FreeBSD x86_64: available

Windows executables are **unsigned**. Azure Artifact Signing is not configured and the repository's existing `WINDOWS_SIGNING_REQUIRED=false` override allowed unsigned publication. Windows may show publisher or SmartScreen warnings.

# jcode

High-performance coding agents.
Run dozens of agents in parallel without melting your machine. More agents, less RAM, no lag.

[![Last Commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/1jehuang/jcode/master?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/commits/master) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/1jehuang/jcode?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/stargazers) [![GitHub Downloads](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2F1jehuang%2Fjcode%2Fmaster%2Fdocs%2Fbadges%2Fdownloads.json&style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/releases) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Community-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/nBe9vGyK9a) [![Y Combinator](https://img.shields.io/badge/Y%20Combinator-S26-F26625?style=flat-square&logo=ycombinator&logoColor=white)](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/jcode) [![X (Twitter)](https://img.shields.io/badge/follow-%401jehuang-000000?style=flat-square&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/1jehuang)

## Swarm Spawn two or more agents in the same repo, and they will automatically be managed by the server to allow native collaboration. When agent A edits a file that agent B has read (code shifting under its feet), the server notifies agent B. Agent B can ignore it if it is not relevant, or it can check the diff to make sure that it doesn't conflict. Each agent has messaging abilities, capable of DMing just one agent, broadcasting to all other agents hosted by the server, or just agents working in that repo. This allows you to spawn multiple sessions in the same repo, and have all conflicts automatically resolved. Agents are also able to spawn their own swarms autonomously. They have a swarm tool which allows them to spawn in their own teamates to accomplish tasks in parallel. Doing so turns the main agent into a coordinator and the spawned agents into workers. Groups of agents, their messaging channels, their completion statuses, etc are all automatically managed. This can be done headlessly or headed. ## OAuth and Providers Supports a [wide range of providers](https://jcode.sh/docs#providers), including Claude OAuth and OpenAI Codex OAuth. ## Customizability / Self-Dev Jcode is inventing a new form of customizability. One that doesn't limit you to what a plugin or extension can do. Tell your jcode agent to enter self dev mode, and it will start modifying its own source code. Jcode is optimized to iterate on itself. There is significant infrastructure around self development, which allows it to edit, build, and test its own source code, then reload its own binary and continue work in your (potentially many) sessions, fully automatically. ## Other - [Token optimization](docs/HARNESS.md#token-optimization) - [KV cache](docs/HARNESS.md#kv-cache) - [Hill-climbable measurements](docs/HARNESS.md#hill-climbable-measurements)
